title: QITT-Enhanced Multi-Scale Substructure Analysis with Learned Topological Embeddings for Cosmological Parameter Estimation

contributions.purpose: 从暗物质晕并合树估计宇宙学参数的新流水线
contributions.mechanism: 多尺度子结构分析 + GraphSAGE 拓扑嵌入 + 量子启发张量列车(QITT)分解,4440 维压缩到 202 维
contributions.domain: 计算宇宙学 / 图深度学习
contributions.source_quote: We propose a framework combining multi-scale substructure analysis, Graph Neural Network (GNN)-learned embeddings, and Quantum-Inspired Tensor Train (QITT) decomposition.

contributions.purpose: 证明 QITT 压缩优于直接展平/原始特征
contributions.mechanism: 对预测误差做配对 t 检验,QITT_XGBoost 对比 B2/B4 基线
contributions.evaluation: QITT vs B4_FlatCombined:Ωm p=0.0104、σ8 p=0.0014;vs B2_RawSubPhys:p=1.9e-8/2.8e-5
contributions.source_quote: QITT-enhanced XGBoost significantly outperformed baselines using raw or flattened features (p < 0.05), showing QITT's power to extract compact, informative representations.

contributions.purpose: 承认简单全局聚合基线对 Ωm 更优(负结果/trade-off)
contributions.mechanism: 对比仅 11 维全局聚合特征基线 B1 与 QITT
contributions.evaluation: B1_Aggregate_LinearRegression R2(Ωm)=0.970 最高;QITT_XGBoost 与 B1_Aggregate_XGBoost 无显著差异(Ωm p=0.954,σ8 p=0.173);σ8 普遍难约束 R2~0.56
contributions.source_quote: a baseline using global aggregate tree features achieved the highest R2 = 0.970 for Ωm with Linear Regression, and its XGBoost variant matched QITT_XGBoost.

notes: 全篇由 Denario 多智能体系统全自动生成(GPT-4.1/Gemini-2.5),AI 参与 checklist 全 [D]。负结果/trade-off 明确:11 维全局聚合基线 R2(Ωm)=0.970 反超 QITT(0.923),且 QITT_XGBoost 与聚合 XGBoost 统计上无差异(p=0.954/0.173),σ8 始终难约束。数据红旗:方法节 2.5.1 称 4440 维重塑为 6 模张量(2,2,2,3,5,37),而结果节 3.2 却说重塑为 3 阶张量(60,2,37)、秩(1,2,2,1)——方法与结果的张量分解描述自相矛盾(幻影/前后不一致)。Paper Checklist 对'Theory assumptions and proofs'答 [Yes] 并称'human evaluators validated ... the assumptions and proofs',但全文无任何定理/证明(通用套话式辩护)。Broader impacts 答 NA。贡献无自声明编号列表,由 abstract+conclusion 归纳。
